title: Cookie, Peanut Butter with Rice Cereal, No Bake

content.title: About
content.content: A ready‑to‑eat snack that combines peanut butter, rice cereal and a touch of sweetener into a no‑bake cookie. It is shelf‑stable, quick to prepare and popular among sweet‑tooth and fitness enthusiasts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The cookie requires no heat – ingredients are simply mixed and shaped.
Rice cereal gives a light, crunchy texture and makes the product airy.
Peanut butter provides plant‑based protein and healthy fats.
Often used as a post‑workout snack for fast energy.
Several flavor variations exist – classic, chocolate‑drizzled, and with dried fruit.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: Peanut butter supplies about 25 % protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Source of healthy fats
items.content: Monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats in peanut butter promote heart health.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Rice cereal adds fiber that aids normal digestion.

items.title: Moderate sugar content
items.content: The recipe uses a modest amount of sugar, making it more suitable for blood‑glucose control.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Combined carbs from the cereal and fats from the peanut butter provide rapid and sustained energy.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: The product can trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to peanuts.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Because of its fat and sugar content, portions should be moderated.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some versions contain added salt; those monitoring sodium should choose a low‑salt option.

items.title: Potential gluten
items.content: If processed with gluten‑containing additives, it may not be suitable for people with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy straight from the pack, crumble into yogurt or smoothies, or use as a base for homemade energy bars. For a firmer bite, briefly microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in a cool, dry place in a sealed container. For storage longer than three months, refrigerate to prevent fat oxidation.
